incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 streaming latency spiked above SLO (2.1s) for the last 12m across prod us-east-1. Error surface: increased tail stalls / cache miss rate. Auto-page to #incidents and oncall. thread_ts=4501234567

emma (oncall): ack. I'm looking. seeing p95 also creeping. starting triage.

raj (sre): saw the same. high miss-rate on prefix-cache: hit-rate dropped from 98% -> 71% around 4501228000 (about ~54m ago). suspect recent rollout touching prefix hashing. linking deploys.

lia (runtime): echo. we rolled prefix-hash v2 at 4501227900 behind a FF (prefix-scheme=v2). It touched hash salt ordering + KV sharding logic.

kai (eng-runtime): can confirm commit d1a2f3 that changed SaltOrder and deterministic salt application for multi-tenant keys. It landed to canaries ~4501227000 and to 40% traffic ~4501227800.

emma (oncall): is there an obvious correlation to miss-rate jump?

lia (runtime): yes — cache key canonicalization changed slightly. older cached keys are not matching new canonical form so prefix lookups miss and we fall back to paging disk.

raj (sre): paging spike -> increased CPU + io wait -> streaming stalls. p99 tailers are requests that hit cold path + disk lookup.

paul (customer-success): We have a customer thread (Acct: DeltaWave) reporting degraded response times for streaming completions, getting noisy. ETA for mitigation?

emma (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) roll back prefix-scheme FF to v1 for 100% traffic, 2) enable warmup job to reindex canonical keys into new format OR 3) route critical customers to fallback model pool that uses old prefix mapping. Which is fastest?

kai (eng-runtime): fastest = kill FF (rollback to v1). It undoes hash canonicalization in-flight. rollback command is via FF-store:```ffstore set prefix-scheme default v1 --env=prod --force```

lia (runtime): note: rollback will not instantly warm caches — but it will start matching cached keys again which should reduce misses quickly. Also we can spin extra page workers to reduce tail while caches stabilize.

raj (sre): I'll scale page workers x2 in us-east-1 now and bump KV read concurrency. Running:
```kubectl -n infra scale deployment page-worker --replicas=6 -l region=us-east-1
redis-cli -h kv-prod-us-east OBJ INFO prefix-cache
```

deploy-bot: deploy 4501227900-prefix-scheme-v2 -> rolled back by emma at 4501230100 (user: emma).

emma (oncall): did rollback. FF-store shows prefix-scheme=v1 for prod. monitoring hit-rate.

lia (runtime): checking logs for cache hits post-rollback. initial sample: hit-rate increased from 71% -> 90% within 3m. still warming.

raj (sre): p99 dropping now. p95 back near normal. streaming stalls reduced, but we still see occasional cold tails from requests that already started under v2 mapping.

emma (oncall): customer-impact note: DeltaWave saw 40% tail failures during window 4501228800-4501230200. Paul, can you patch customers with an interim message? we should be transparent.

paul (customer-success): on it. drafting update: "We're investigating increased latency; we rolled back a recent prefix update and we're seeing improvement. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline for full fix." will ping product for official wording. :thumbsup:

lia (runtime): next steps: 1) create reindex/warmup job to canonicalize keys so v2 can roll forward safely; 2) add migration-safe key normalization so both formats match; 3) add rollout guard to detect hit-rate delta > 5% and auto-pause. I'll open PRs.

kai (eng-runtime): agree. I'll add a canary probe that checks hit-rate delta and prevents >5% drop at 50% traffic.

raj (sre): operational followups: add runbook step to scale page workers and route high-priority customers to old pool if miss-rate > 10%. I'll update oncall runbook.

emma (oncall): handoff: I'm wrapping up—latency stabilized but we'll keep monitoring. Handoff to kai as the lead on remediation. Next oncall is raj in 2h; please keep him posted.

kai (eng-runtime): taking over remediation. creating issue INF-821: "prefix canonicalization rollout regression" with timeline and mitigation steps.

paul (customer-success): I'll follow up with DeltaWave after 30m with an update.

emma (oncall): final status: SLO breached window 4501228800-4501230100. Root cause: prefix-hash canonicalization change (v2) introduced mismatch with cached keys -> increased cache miss-rate -> paging and streaming tail stalls. Mitigation: FF rollback at 4501230100, scale page workers, route-critical traffic to fallback pool. Action items assigned to kai/lia/raj/paul.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE (4501231800): Severity set to Sev2, postmortem required. Escalation to Eng Runtime and Customer Success.

raj (sre): adding logs and metrics snapshot to the incident ticket. saving timeseries for p95/p99, cache hit-rate, paging ops.

kai (eng-runtime): leaving notes for next shift: do not re-enable prefix-scheme=v2 until reindex job confirmed and canary probe passes for 24h. PRs: #4387 (migration), #4388 (canary probe).

paul (customer-success): DeltaWave acknowledged and appreciated quick mitigation. asking for ETA on permanent fix and whether their traffic needs special routing. I told them we'll follow-up in the postmortem.

emma (oncall): thanks all. I'll close bridge in 10m unless anything else pops. :white_check_mark:
